statement: A dispute start the node asked for that can never open a dispute is forgotten, so the node may ask again. The Entity keeps its own start as a record (`starting`, R-DISPUTE-FINALIZE) and refuses a second ask while it stands (`dispute_pending`), so a start that never lands would refuse every later ask until the epoch moved. The Host's builder probes each dispute start in its draft alone at the head (R-SIMULATE): one the chain would revert is dropped from the draft and the rows and named, and the Host tells the Entity of its own peer and nonce (`j_start_lapsed`, in the WAL like any J input). The Entity clears the record only when the lapse names the nonce of the start it holds and the chain has not given that start a window; a lapse of another nonce, of a start with a window, or with no record changes nothing. A start the batch's answer says the chain skipped for good (the stored nonce already reached it, reason 0, or the epoch moved on, reason 11; Account.sol 73-83) is told as lapsed the same way, so the record is cleared and a new ask is taken. A start skipped because a dispute is already open (reason 1) is not: it may be the node's own start, restated after it landed, and the dispute reaches the Entity as a chain fact (`j_epoch`, `j_dispute_over`). A start that reverts only together with the ops it is grouped with is kept. A counter the node asked for (R-DISPUTE-WATCH) lapses only when the chain will refuse it for good: the builder probes each dispute op in the draft alone before the draft is sealed whole, and names a counter only when every cause the simulation gives is E2, E4 or E9 (not authorized or stale, a bad signature, a hash mismatch) or a skip with reason 3 to 7 (the dispute moved, the window closed, the counter is not newer, it was superseded, one is already registered). The Host then tells the Entity (`j_counter_lapsed`, the peer and the counter's nonce); the Entity marks the answer lapsed and does not restate it. A counter the batch landed and skipped for reasons 3 to 7 is told the same way; one skipped for another reason is not. A counter held for a reason that can heal (an error the Host cannot name, no dispute open yet at a lagging node) is dropped from the draft for now and not named: the Entity restates it at each frame while the window is open, so it is asked again. A finalize the chain would revert (the other party's landed first, the dispute is over) is probed and dropped the same way and not named; the Entity asks again until it hears the dispute over. A lapse of another nonce changes nothing. Owed: a start that is held for another reason (gas cap, size) stays held and the record stands.
source: Review A on #156 (lapsed start must clear the record); coordinator 10-02 09:10 order; contracts-decisions.md One start per dispute

layers.arrival: n/a: the Arrival page models the Account's frames; a dropped start is an Entity and Host rule
layers.quint: n/a: the Quint model has the chain's dispute cells; what the node keeps of its own ask is not one of them
layers.contract: n/a: the chain reverts or skips a start by its own rules (J2, S1); this row is what the node does when the chain would revert it
layers.rig: n/a: an off-chain Entity and Host rule

killers.name: R-DISPUTE-LAPSED the lapse of the start the node asked for clears its record, and a new ask is taken
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED while the record stands a second ask is still refused
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a lapse of another nonce, or of a start that has its window, changes nothing
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a Host that restarts after the lapse still has no record of the start
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a start that would revert is dropped from the draft and named, nothing is sent
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a start that simulates cleanly is sealed and sent, not dropped
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a start the chain would revert is dropped and the Entity may ask again
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a start a signed batch also carries is not dropped: that batch may still land
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a start held for want of gas room, not for a revert, stays in the draft
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a counter the chain would revert is dropped and not asked for again
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a counter the Host dropped, because the chain would revert it, is not asked for again
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a lapse of another nonce changes nothing, and a registered counter still finalizes
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a counter held for a reason that can heal is not given up: it is asked for again
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a counter whose revert the Host cannot name is not given up either
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a counter the batch skipped for good (window closed) lapses, a skip that can heal does not
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a start the chain skipped for good (stored nonce reached, epoch left) is told as lapsed
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a start skipped because a dispute is open stays: it may be its own, restated
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a counter that landed and was skipped for good lapses, one skipped as unknown does not
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a counter that reverts for good is dropped and named though a lower group still seals
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a counter held for a reason that can heal is dropped, not named, and what is behind it seals
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a counter that simulates cleanly is not probed away: it is sealed with what is behind it
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a finalize the other party's landed first is dropped, not named, and asked for again
R-DISPUTE-LAPSED a finalize that simulates cleanly is sealed and sent, not dropped
